lessons.text: On longs, refusing is wrong when price sits 0% to 0.5% above VWAP and the stock is up less than about 2.3% so far, so take these. Pass on longs stretched more than 0.6% above VWAP or up more than 2.5% on the day, because the rule plan lost on all three such longs here, whatever the relative volume.

Favour shorts when the index is down and the stock is also down on the day: the rule plan made money in 6 of 6 such filled cases here, so do not refuse them. Pass on shorts when the index is up or the stock is green on the day: the rule plan lost or went flat in all four such cases.

reviews.summary: The Judge was right on moderate longs it took near VWAP (13) and on shorts taken with a falling index (8, 21), and it correctly refused shorts against a rising index or on a stock that was up (3, 7, 22). It refused too much: it passed five longs sitting just above VWAP that the rule plan made money on (0, 5, 11, 12) and one short in a down market (20), all at conviction 2. It lost on longs that were already stretched above VWAP or up a lot on the day (15, 23, 25), and its own tighter levels turned rule-plan winners into losses on two down-market shorts (18, 19).
